āragga.cp: neut. the point of a needle or an awl.
āragga.p: [Ārā+agga] (na) CL=8 Ārāgra-saṃ] edge of chisel, edge of bradawl,tip  of pin, tip of needle.

C: āragga，（nt．），the point of a needle or an awl．
P: Āragga，（nt．） [ārā + agga; Sk．ārāgra of ārā an awl，a prick] the point of an awl，the head of certain arrows，having the shape of an awl，or an arrow of that kind （see Halayudha p．151） A．I，65; Sn．625，631; Dh．401，407; Vism．306; DhA II 51; IV，181．（Page 107）
